review.coverage: x in {-1e9,-1,0,1,1e9}, exact triangular targets, answer offsets 0/1/2 beyond first T(n)>=|x|, negative targets; official rows include 999961559..999961561 near T(44720).
review.incorrectAreAlgorithmic: Every incorrect source read in full; each prints a numerically wrong single answer on at least one valid test (not just formatting/debug output).
review.independentOracle: abs(x); smallest n with T(n)=n(n+1)/2 >= |x| and (T(n)-|x|) even; cross-checked against BFS over signed jump sums for every x in [-300,300].
review.officialTests: official_tests_complete; every official pinned-row pair present in package (inputs equal after CRLF normalization, outputs token-equal); source row byte-equal to independently downloaded, hash-verified pinned open-r1/codeforces parquet row.
review.oracleResult: All 185 package tests and all samples pass strict format/range parse; every expected output equals my oracle; all official upstream rows also equal my oracle.
review.preservedContradictions: build-gaps/11B.json is a superseded diagnostic not consumed by publication_gate. Prior signoff was revoked in 6c46613 for ambiguous flattened bounds; this audit binds only the new normalized package 9e900e57a1c74f68033a6b0e43390e3f2518c9a2e463938fa401431aaa0bf52e.
review.sandbox: Own harness (sha256 c582ff42...983d0d, not worker pool_harness): pinned python@sha256:5887f265...05d3, --network=none, --read-only, --user=65534, --cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, pids<=32, 1 CPU, 2560m memory, RLIMIT_CPU/AS at problem limits, bounded output, launched from env -i shell without credentials; re-run against the normalized-six archive bytes.
review.singleAnswer: Output is one integer uniquely determined by the input; token comparison is correct, no special checker, no float tolerance.
review.statement: Packaged input bound "- 10<sup>9</sup> ≤ x ≤ 10<sup>9</sup>"; original package HTML ("- 109 ≤ x ≤ 109") preserved byte-identical in statement-sources/11B.original.html; diff is exactly that one line. Attested public English source https://codeforces.me/contest/11/problem/B raw snapshot hash 9b6c9747... matches attestation and contains sup.upper-index markup; I re-fetched it and Luogu CF11B independently (both show 10^9). All 30 official inputs within [-1e9,1e9], 27 exceed |109|.
review.submissionProvenance: All 10 sources byte-identical (sha256) to rows in pinned open-r1/codeforces-submissions shards (shard sha256 verified independently); evidence sourceHash equals sha256 of those bytes.
